status.summary: October 9 site reporting describes Phase 2 engineers performing pre-operation functional tests. Named project manager Zhang Yuanyuan states that civil structure, external walls and MEP installation are complete and the validation round remains. End-October testing/acceptance and year-end operation are forecasts. This is attributed reporting, not an official inspection.

locator.precision: Operator-selected parent-campus marker transformed from BD09 by EOIA inversion of the documented Baidu GPS-to-BD09 API. It does not identify a phase building, footprint, construction extent or surveyed campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: The existing operator directory explicitly names Boda Langfang No. 2 and binds it to its selected Baidu campus point. The October 12 report explicitly identifies Phase 2 at that same campus and separately discusses Phase 1. Reuse the prior reviewed BD09-to-WGS84 campus marker; no Phase 2 building position is asserted.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Operator provides no measured positional accuracy. Absolute transformation accuracy and offset to individual phase buildings remain unknown. Numerical API roundtrip residuals and six output decimal places are not ground accuracy bounds.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed all 406 base sites and 430 projects. The same campus already contains Phase 1, project 760bbd20-e137-5015-9956-1d5b17000e18. Phase 2 is a separately identified construction and testing scope. No existing Phase 2 project key or other Langfang No. 2 phase record exists.
additions.successor_review: October 12 report records the October 9 test state and future end-October acceptance/year-end production. No subsequent achieved acceptance or operating observation was established through October 14. Prior blocked Langfang-government route was not retried; the accessible Hebei CAC republication is captured separately.

additions.site_name: China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2
additions.name: China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2.1

status.summary: Contractor September 14 report confirms Phase 2.1 main structures have topped out. This is a dated confirmation of achieved shell state; the exact recent topping-out day remains unknown. Data center, supporting machine room and 220 kV substation are the stated scope. No completion, operation or Phase 2.2 status is inferred.

locator.precision: Approximate representative point inside the named Phase 2 parent property, rounded to four decimals. It does not locate the Phase 2.1 buildings, active work, entrance, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary or Phase 1 property.
locator.identity_review: CSCEC explicitly confirms Phase 2.1. The authority-approved Phase 2 plan names the same project and shows a unique property east of Runhe Road, west of Yebo Road, south of Canghong Road and north of Zongqi River. The consultation drawing confirms these four limits. Runhe/Canghong and Runhe/Zhoude junctions anchor the plan, with Runhe/Danyi withheld as a check. No Phase 1 F07-01 point is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The plan and community road map provide no measured absolute accuracy. Two fit controls and the withheld check are collinear; the official north-up 1:750 plan supports isotropic scale, but the 8.44 m residual does not independently verify east-west or absolute ground accuracy. Rounded point denotes only the broad Phase 2 property.

additions.distinctness_review: All 430 baseline project/source records checked for Lingang, 临港, Runhe, 润荷 and F03-03; no matches. All 406 site coordinates checked; nearest baseline site is National AI Computing Center, Solaseado (Haenam) at 592.84 km. One named Phase 2 property and one Phase 2.1 project; no extra building or Phase 2.2 count.
additions.successor_review: Bounded October 14 primary contractor and indexed project searches recovered the same September 14 achieved-shell confirmation. September 30 B1/C1a MEP procurement and October utility-service procurement leads do not prove achieved completion or operation and are not used to advance status.

additions.name: Sakura Ishikari Data Center Existing Operations

status.summary: Dated operator announcement confirms continued operation of the named Ishikari campus since 2011. July 28 is current operating confirmation, not first opening or proof of Building 3 C/D completion.

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point inside the named Sakura Ishikari parent campus. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, campus boundary, building footprint, or Building 3 C/D fit-out location.
locator.identity_review: The municipal plan labels Sakura Internet Ishikari Data Center on the compound south of Minato-dori and west of the parallel main road. Its perpendicular long buildings, the circular Sun Village sports hall across Minato-dori, the northwest small compound, and the surrounding road geometry match the GSI map. The point is selected within that identified campus only.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Municipal and GSI maps provide no surveyed accuracy for this analyst-selected point; map vintage and manual matching add unquantified uncertainty. Four decimal places are output to avoid implying building or survey precision.

additions.distinctness_review: All 406 baseline sites, 430 projects and 231 source records checked across Sakura, さくら, Ishikari and 石狩 aliases. No Sakura site/project or source-record identity match. The IIJ Shiroi text mention is context only. Nearest existing site is Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 about 232 m northwest, with a different operator/property and BroadBand Tower tenancy. City directory separately lists both facilities. Regional DCC cooperation does not establish shared-campus or lease identity; no contrary primary identity bridge was found.
additions.successor_review: July 27 completed power maintenance independently corroborates live container-facility services. August 3 SOC notice calls Ishikari an operated campus, while its audit period ends May 31; audit receipt is not used as a physical opening or later audit observation. July 28 remains the selected unambiguous whole-campus present-tense confirmation. No dated achieved C/D fit-out observation was established in the July 28 presentation or 2026 integrated report.
